scope: Affinity purification of the biotinylated proteins was adapted from the method developed by Mackmull et al
Streptavidin Sepharose High Performance beads (80 μl; GE Healthcare, 17-5113-01) were equilibrated in 1 ml of lysis buffer

One microgram of Sequencing Modified Trypsin (Promega, V5117) was added, and the samples were incubated at 37°C for 16 hours under constant shaking (500 rpm).
the digested peptides were eluted with 150 μl of 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate (pH 8).
